question: What details are kept for each order and the items in it?
answer: Each `Order` row keeps an autoincrement `id`, a `userId` foreign key tied to `User`, a `status` of type `OrderStatus` defaulting to `PENDING`, a `createdAt` timestamp, an `items` relation, and an index on `userId` [prisma/schema.prisma:36-45]. The possible `status` values are the `OrderStatus` enum values `PENDING`, `PAID`, and `SHIPPED` [prisma/schema.prisma:13-17]. Each `OrderItem` keeps only its own `id`, an `orderId` linking it to its `Order`, a `productId` linking it to its `Product`, and the ordered `quantity` [prisma/schema.prisma:47-54].
